answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Reaching the echo of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The sparrow lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the river is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
